multiInstanceAnalysis.question: Could a second, stale-code backend instance be producing eta.* events?
multiInstanceAnalysis.proof1: Only PID 32528 holds port 3000. The other two are the wrapper and watch supervisor of the same invocation.
multiInstanceAnalysis.proof2: Observation window measured exactly +36 attempts across 6 rows in 30s = 6 attempts/row = 1 claim per row per 5s tick, which equals EVENTS_OUTBOX_INTERVAL_MS exactly. A second active processor would have produced ~2x that rate. Therefore exactly ONE outbox processor is running.
multiInstanceAnalysis.proof3: The outbox processor is gated by runWithLeaderLock('maintenance:event_outbox'), so duplicates cannot double-process regardless.
multiInstanceAnalysis.housekeeping: PIDs 23136/26276 are redundant leftovers of the dev watch chain and can be tidied, but they are NOT a root cause and were left running.
